generar-qr.title: QR Code Generator
generar-qr.description: Turn a link or a bit of text into a downloadable QR code, without uploading anything.
generar-qr.cta: Need to generate QR codes from your system (menus, orders, tickets)? We'll integrate it for you.
generar-qr.seoTitle: QR Code Generator: Free, No Sign-Up Needed | SonhoLab
generar-qr.seoDescription: Turn any link or text into a QR code you can download and print at any size. Free, no signup, and nothing is uploaded: it all happens in your browser.
generar-qr.intro: Paste a link or type some text and you get a QR code image, ready to download and print on a sign, a menu or a business card. The code is drawn inside your browser, so nothing travels to a server of ours. And since the image is yours, it never expires and doesn't depend on any outside service.
generar-qr.stepsHeading: How to make your QR code
generar-qr.step1Text: Drop in your website link, your WhatsApp number or whatever text you want to show. The code redraws as you type.
generar-qr.step2Text: Point your phone camera at the code on screen and check that it opens the right link before you send anything to print.
generar-qr.step3Text: Save the code as an image and drop it into your sign, your menu or your card. It stays on your device, with no watermark and no signup.
generar-qr.useCase1: A restaurant that sticks the QR for its digital menu on every table and changes dishes without reprinting.
generar-qr.useCase2: Someone who sells over WhatsApp and wants customers to message from a QR printed on the flyer or the package.
generar-qr.useCase3: An office assistant putting together an event invite, adding a QR with the venue map and the RSVP form.
generar-qr.faq1q: Is it free, or is there a limit?
generar-qr.faq1a: It's free and there's no cap on how many codes you make. We don't ask for an email, an account or a subscription, and there's no paid tier with hidden features. Generate as many as you need, one after another, in the same day.
generar-qr.faq2q: What happens to the link or text I type in?
generar-qr.faq2a: It stays on your device. The code is drawn by the browser you're already using, so what you type never gets sent to a server of ours and isn't stored anywhere. Close the tab and nothing is left behind.
generar-qr.faq3q: Does the QR code expire after a while?
generar-qr.faq3a: No. It's a static QR: the link is written into the image itself, not routed through a shortener of ours. It keeps working as long as the site it points to stays online. The trade-off is that once it's printed, you can't change the destination without making a new one.
generar-qr.faq4q: Do I need to install anything or create an account?
generar-qr.faq4a: None of that. It runs in the browser you already have, on a computer or a phone, and there's no program to download. There's no queue either: the code shows up as soon as you finish typing.
generar-qr.faq5q: Is the image good enough to print large?
generar-qr.faq5a: Yes. Generate the code at the largest size you can and use it on posters or storefront windows. Always leave a white margin around it and don't stretch it: if the image gets distorted, phone cameras stop reading it.
